query:
SELECT
                COALESCE((SELECT email_verified FROM users WHERE id = $1), false)
                    as "email_verified!",
                EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1 FROM user_restrictions
                    WHERE user_id = $1 AND kind = 'map_publishing'::restriction_kind
                        AND start_time <= now() AND end_time > now()
                ) as "restricted!"
